scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix api && npm run db:generate --prefix api && npm ci --prefix mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix api && npm run lint --prefix mobile
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix api && npm run format --prefix mobile
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix api && npm run format:check --prefix mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix api && npm run typecheck --prefix mobile
scripts.test: npm test --prefix api && npm run test:mobile --prefix mobile -- --watch=false
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-android.ps1
